title: 2.11 Big and Small
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Say a thing is big, small, new or old, and that two things are the same or different.
grammar_function: Der/Die/Das + noun + ist + adjective; Die + plural + sind gleich/verschieden.
speaking_outcome: Describe the size and age of things.
